scenes.title: A boat at pier four
scenes.summary: Sela Thorn agrees to row the party for two silver and offers a first-light departure tomorrow, refusing night travel. She says Saltmere Mine flooded when the bell first rang forty years ago, and recounts her grandmother's report of warm water.

scenes.title: The flooded Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: The party explores a tunnel flooded with warm black water and finds hymn-book pages, one marked "M. Brand"; Teo identifies the handwriting as his sister Mira's. Vessa and Oren suspect Maren's involvement with the choir; the search yields nothing further, and Oren takes two damage from bad air.

scenes.title: The midnight bell
scenes.place: Shore below the drowned chapel, Gullwick
scenes.summary: A fisherman warns that the Kelp Mother takes children near the water. At midnight the submerged bell rings twelve times, the humming grows louder, and pale figures appear in rows on the chapel floor before vanishing; the GM notes the choir clock at three of six.

scenes.title: Tomorrow's chapel dive
scenes.summary: The party plans a first-light boat trip with Sela and a daytime dive to the chapel at low tide; Vessa plans to buy rope and another lantern. Bram says Maren lost a brother to the bay, and the party takes a long rest, returning to full health.
